About our mission

Technovation is the official networking club of ABES Engineering College, Ghaziabad. We help students connect beyond their branch and year, learn from peers, and turn ideas into campus projects.

Whether you build, design, organize events, or write, there is a department here ready for your energy.

Base at: ABES Engineering College, Ghaziabad

Student networkingMixers and meetups across every branch and year.
Peer learningWorkshops led by students who have shipped real builds.
